findings.title: Reconcile the remaining dependency contracts with both registry profiles
findings.body: The new profile table correctly distinguishes the deployments, but this endpoint row still unconditionally promises ReadWriteOncePod storage and a Recreate writer. The linked dependency reference also describes `registry-local` as retained storage with delete disabled (`docs/site/understand/platform-and-operations.md:389`), and its recovery row assumes a retained registry (`:313`). The Argo-selected workload actually has no persistent volume and enables deletion (`gitops/platform/registry-local/resources.yaml:21–25`); its Application selects that directory (`gitops/platform/bootstrap/registry-local.yaml:16`). Operators following these contracts can therefore choose recovery or maintenance based on storage that does not exist. Qualify these statements by profile and link the ephemeral-loss stop/rebuild/new-release procedure from the dependency recovery guidance. Both profiles must remain within A97-02; the accurate new table alone does not reconcile the contradictory contracts.

overall_explanation:
WHOLE COM-010: sourceAccuracy NOT_READY; readerUsability NOT_READY; quality NOT_READY. The new registry table and loss/rebuild boundaries match the renderer, selected bootstrap and manifests, but unconditional retained-storage claims remain in the canonical endpoint catalogue and linked dependency/recovery contracts. A97-02 remains NOT_READY for its full dependency scope, including both registry profiles.

WHOLE OPR-010: sourceAccuracy PASS; readerUsability PASS; quality PASS at the source-documentation level. Preserve the existing full journey scope, including correct-revision approval, preview, publication/export/handoff and stale/concurrent recovery. Documented unsupported routes and runtime prerequisites remain limitations, not successful browser or live evidence.

Impact audit: preserve AP09.7-ready-data-topics-20261020 acceptance for COM-002/006/007, DAT-002/003/007 and TEL-001/004/005/006/007; AP09-selected-model-gateway-20261021 for INF-012 and A97-03; AP09-communication-complete-contracts-20261021 for COM-003/004/005/012; and AP09-private-routes-complete-20261021 for COM-009. The remaining defect concerns COM-010 and the registry portion of A97-02; those accepted scopes are neither narrowed nor globally revoked.

Checker receipt changes excluded. Read-only inspection only; no tests, product execution, rendered UI, native or live acceptance claimed. No whole-package acceptance asserted.
